question_text: A bar of annealed $85 \mathrm{Cu}-15 \mathrm{Zn}$ (12-mm diameter) is cold-drawn through a die with a diameter of 10 mm . What are (a) the tensile strength and (b) the ductility of the resulting bar? Give your answer as a tuple: (tensile_strength, ductility).The units of each required answer are (MPa, %), respectively.
response:
## Step 2: Read Properties from the Cold-Work Curves

Using the standard tensile-strength and ductility versus percent-cold-work curves for annealed 85Cu-15Zn brass (from Callister, Figure 7.19):

**At %CW ≈ 30.6%:**

**(a) Tensile strength:** The TS curve rises steeply from the annealed value (~260 MPa) and reaches approximately **460 MPa** at 30.6% cold work.

**(b) Ductility:** The %EL curve drops from the annealed value (~47%) and reaches approximately **18%** at 30.6% cold work.

## Summary

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| % Cold Work | 30.6% |
| (a) Tensile strength | ≈ 460 MPa |
| (b) Ductility (%EL) | ≈ 18% |

$$\boxed{(460,\ 18)}$$
